properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: MAC/digest comparison posture in web3x. The one substantive site is encryption.ts:92 — the V3 keystore integrity MAC (keccak256 of derivedKey[16:32]||ciphertext) compared with !== instead of crypto.timingSafeEqual on the wallet decrypt path. The other 7 sites compare public keccak256 digests for dispatch: ABI function selectors (contract-abi.ts:53), event topic signatures (contract.ts:260), and genesis-block constants for chain-type detection (net.ts:50-58) — no secret material, timing leak has

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ethereum V3 keystore private-key encryption uses AES-128-CTR via browserify-aes ^1.2.0 (encrypt() default options.cipher='aes-128-ctr'; decrypt() takes the cipher name from the keystore JSON) — the algorithm is fixed by the Web3 Secret Storage V3 standard. CTR is unauthenticated; integrity comes from the separate keccak MAC. Changeable here in principle, but the format is interoperability-bound to the V3 spec.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: PBKDF2 iteration posture: pbkdf2.ts:22 is the live HMAC-SHA256 PBKDF2 whose production default c=262144 (V3 keystore, encryption.ts:123) is genuinely below OWASP's 600k for HMAC-SHA256 — real, but the value is fixed by the Ethereum Web3 Secret Storage spec. scrypt.ts:132's c=1 is the RFC 7914 scrypt block-expansion construction, not a password-verification KDF — matched on the literal, not a weakness.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: secp256k1 ECDSA in the in-repo EVM: precompile 0x01 ecrecover, exported at index.ts:8 and implemented in 01-ecdsa-recovery-account.ts:38 via recover() from web3x/utils (eth-lib account, elliptic secp256k1); plus the elliptic ^6.4.0 lockfile declaration behind it. Shor-broken signature primitive — changeable here as code, but the operation's semantics are fixed by the Ethereum protocol.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 across the V3 keystore paths: KDF branch + derivation calls in encryption.ts (encrypt :122/:124, decrypt :77/:84, c=262144 default), the wrapper implementation (pbkdf2.ts:22, PRF fixed to sha256), the RFC 7914 scrypt-internal c=1 calls (scrypt.ts:132/:279), the keystore format type (:49), the public API export (index.ts:29), and dependency declarations (web3x/package.json:72, web3x-codegen/yarn.lock:1492).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: In-tree scrypt implementation (adapted from scryptsy) — the DEFAULT KDF for V3 keystore encryption with Ethereum-spec params n=8192, r=8, p=1, dklen=32 (below modern OWASP scrypt recommendations of n≥32768, but the format-standard parameters); also re-exported in the package public API. Its internal PBKDF2-SHA256 c=1 calls are the RFC 7914 construction, not password-KDF iterations.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-128-CTR symmetric encryption of the wallet private key inside V3 keystores: 128-bit key = derivedKey[0:16] from scrypt/PBKDF2, provider browserify-aes ^1.2.0 (web3x/package.json:66). Grover halves the 128-bit margin (CNSA 2.0 wants AES-256). Algorithm is fixed by the Web3 Secret Storage V3 format — changeable here only at the cost of keystore interoperability.
